snippet.title: Million Depth – Nintendo Switch Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://playism.com/game/million-depth/
Falling, again and again—only to find the "you" I believed in...
Million Depth is coming to Nintendo Switch on December 3, 2026!

The physical edition comes with a special first-print bonus: a deluxe 2-disc original soundtrack featuring all 72 tracks.

▼ Physical pre-orders are open now!
https://playism.com/game/million-depth/

Developer: Cyber Space Biotope
Publisher: PLAYISM
